criteria.text: Delta 600s + daily full, normal/restore modes, controlled startup; verification: Worker schedule/registration, deploy allowlist and repeated-start tests
Eligible modified-since interface and stock-operation completeness; verification: Local operation fixtures + named provider coverage evidence; gate remains closed when absent
Complete paged merge and consistent data/cursor; verification: Empty delta, zero, overlap, equal timestamps, page 2 failure, caps, restart/crash tests
One valid writer, no stale overwrites; verification: Concurrent full/delta, lease expiry, Redis commit failure and lock-owner tests using disposable local Redis
Truthful retention, coverage age and cache compatibility; verification: >24h synthetic idle catalog, failed sync, >1h degraded coverage, legacy/corrupt/missing state and rollback tests
Selected-SKU fresh bulk reads before quote; verification: Stale cached 10 vs live 2; actual HTTP bypass, chunking, identity, SKU aliases, unknown mapping and incomplete bulk tests
Quote consent/idempotency/deferral unchanged; verification: No-consent and already-sent turns make no critical read/write; 429 defers; retry freshly reads and creates at most once
Inactive/removed/new/renamed items stay truthful; verification: No false 0, no stale alias resurrection, new mapping discovered, no website product/price/embedding mutations
Rate limits are respected across processes; verification: Retry-After 1800, small inline retry, concurrent cooldown extension, skipped-job and recovery tests
Reduction is measured, not guessed; verification: Simulated 24h 157-call scenario and burst/multi-page scenarios, shared counters and no redundant customer full scans
Local quality and user-path integration pass; verification: Focused pytest acceptance, real local Redis race tests, Ruff/format, mypy; no provider writes or paid model calls
Exact source and remaining live gates are reviewable; verification: Commit-bound report, Beads/handoff, rollback instructions; provider coverage/activation/24h proof listed separately
